lines.zh: 发出沙沙声，快速挪动模糊身影。
lines.en: Makes a rustling sound, moves quickly in a hazy form.

lines.zh: 发出低沉嘶嘶声，步履蹒跚。
身体半透明，闪烁着绿色光点。
目光空洞地盯着前方，缓慢移动。
lines.en: Empty eyes fixed forward, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 缓缓前行，手中紧握古旧物品。
lines.en: Advances slowly, clutching old items tightly.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的咕哝声，摸索着前进。
lines.en: Makes a soft grumbling sound, feeling its way forward.

lines.zh: 缓慢前行，眼神中透露出贪婪。
在地面上留下模糊的足迹。
lines.en: Leaves hazy footprints on the ground.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的呢喃声，继续前行。
lines.en: Makes a weak whisper, continues moving.
Lugging a sack of goods, swaying step by step.
I shuffle along the wall, wary of light.

lines.zh: 脚下发虚，货物叮当作响。
lines.en: My steps are unsteady, wares clinking.

lines.zh: 站在阴影中，目光空洞地四处游荡。
lines.en: Standing in shadows, eyes empty, looking around.

lines.zh: 低垂着脑袋，似乎在沉思。
lines.en: Head hung low, seems in thought.

lines.zh: 摇摇欲坠地倚靠在墙上。
在废墟间徘徊，目光空洞。
手中拿着发光的旧物品。
目光呆滞地盯着手中物品。
lines.en: Staring blankly at the item in hand.

lines.zh: 坐在破烂的箱子上，显得疲惫。
lines.en: Sitting on a broken box, looking tired.

lines.zh: 半透明的身躯在月光下闪烁。
目光紧盯着某个看不见的目标。
lines.en: Eyes fixed on an unseen target.
Leaning lazily against a pile of stones.

lines.zh: 把货袋翻了个遍，数着珠子。
lines.en: I rummage through my sack, counting beads.
I keep my stall and wait for a buyer.

lines.zh: 眯起眼，认不清手里的钱。
lines.en: I squint, unable to tell the coins apart.
So drowsy I nearly doze off.

lines.zh: 突然抬起头，目光凶狠地盯着玩家。
lines.en: Rises suddenly, vicious eyes fixed on the player.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，似乎准备攻击。
目光闪烁，仿佛预见了什么。
lines.en: Eyes flicker, as if foreseeing something.

lines.zh: 低声呢喃，似乎在咒语中。
lines.en: Whispers softly, as if in a spell.

lines.zh: 身体猛然一震，目光锁定玩家。
lines.en: Body jolts, eyes lock on the player.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的咆哮声，准备行动。
lines.en: Makes a soft growl, readying itself.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁不定，似乎在思考对策。
紧张地盯着玩家，全身紧绷。
目光突然闪烁，似乎有所察觉。
lines.en: Eyes suddenly flicker, as if noticing something.
Got coin on you, living one?
Rattle your coin purse and I'll look up.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着市集的泥。
lines.en: Your boots carry the market's mud.
Everything I sell came by honest means.
Come closer, my eyes are bad.
What's wrong with your little eyes?
My sack is torn and the beads are rolling away!

lines.zh: 商人也会流血，快付钱救我。
lines.en: Merchants bleed too — pay up and save me.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的咕噜声，露出尖牙。
目光闪烁，盯着你手中的食物。
lines.en: Stares at your food, eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 从长袍中掏出一块发光的腐肉。
lines.en: Pulls out a glowing rotting meat from his robes.

lines.zh: 举起一只腐烂的手，试图触摸你。
lines.en: Raises a rotting hand, trying to touch you.

lines.zh: 用手指向地上的腐烂果子。
lines.en: Points at the rotten fruit on the ground.

lines.zh: 发出咯咯的笑声，似乎在嘲笑你。
从长袍中拿出一串闪烁的珠子。
lines.en: Pulls out a shimmering string of beads.

lines.zh: 用嘶哑的声音说，‘交易吧。’
一撞之下，你感觉到了它的冷冰冰的皮肤。
lines.en: You feel its cold skin upon collision.

lines.zh: 被它撞开，你感到一阵剧痛。
lines.en: Knocked away, you feel intense pain.

lines.zh: 它用尖利的爪子抓向你。
lines.en: Its sharp claws grab at you.

lines.zh: 撞到它时，你撞得头昏眼花。
它迅速地撞向你，试图撞晕你。
lines.en: Collides with you, trying to stun you.

lines.zh: 你撞到它，它的身体发出吱吱声。
lines.en: You collide, and its body creaks.

lines.zh: 撞到它的一瞬间，它的声音很响。
撞到它，你看到它的血珠四溅。
lines.en: You see blood splatter upon collision.

lines.zh: 突然撞上它，你感到一阵冰寒。
lines.en: You feel a sudden chill upon collision.

lines.zh: 被它撞到，你感觉呼吸困难。
lines.en: Breath taken away by the collision.

lines.zh: 向你发出低沉的呼唤声。
向你发出嘶嘶的求偶声。
向你发出咕噜咕噜的声音。
它向你发出求偶的低语。
发出咕噜咕噜的声音，似乎在求偶。
lines.en: 发出咕噜声, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 用嘶哑的声音向你求偶。
lines.en: 用嘶哑的声音求偶, 'Hoarse mating call.'

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，似乎在与你互动。
发出咕噜声，似乎在寻找伴侣。

lines.en: Be my partner in this trade.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，你发现了他的身影。
你瞥见了他阴森的目光。
他的尖牙在月光下闪耀。
lines.en: His fangs glint in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 昏沉地精商人用细长的手指摸索。
他突然转身，露出锋利的爪子。
他低语着什么，声音模糊不清。
他的眼睛闪烁着不祥的光芒。
lines.en: His eyes glow with ill omen.

lines.zh: 他那瘦削的手臂伸向你。
lines.en: His bony arm reaches for you.

lines.zh: 昏沉地精商人低声吟唱咒语。
他的声音如同远古的低语。
lines.en: His voice is an ancient whisper.

lines.zh: 他仿佛感受到了你的存在。
他的脸上露出诡异的笑容。
lines.en: His face splits in a grin.

lines.zh: 他似乎在计算你的弱点。

lines.en: Ask the price first, then draw the blade.
If the deal fails, I take it anyway.
Is he buying, or is he dying?

lines.zh: 他挥舞着匕首向你砍去。
lines.en: He swings a dagger at you.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛盯着你的每一个动作。
lines.en: His eyes follow your every move.
He thrusts a spike at you.
He growls and lunges at you.
He swings a spike at you.

lines.zh: 他用短刀割裂你的皮肤。
lines.en: He slashes your skin with a short knife.

lines.zh: 价钱谈不拢，就别怪手滑。
lines.en: If the price is wrong, my hand may slip.
Even a drowsy groglin can do the math.
I will cut open your pack first.
Market rule: the highest bid wins.
Your life is not worth many coins.
I will not lose on this deal.
Your account isn't settled; the dagger will bill you.
Get out of my way, tiny thing!
Don't force me to use venom!
This cut goes on your bill!
I take the goods and keep you!
Touch my wares, pay the price!
Do not blame a groglin for being cold!
I set up my stall and wait for customers.
The drowsy groglin opens for business.
The night market is just opening.
I lean out from behind the pile of goods.
Who wants to buy my old wares?
I wake with a sack full of junk.
I open my eyes while counting beads.

lines.zh: 着火了！我的货烧起来了！
lines.en: I'm on fire! My goods are burning!
